extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys/agents, national IP offices, and WIPO users
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts the substantive treaty headings (Articles and Chapters) of the Patent Cooperation Treaty that set out requirements, procedures, and standards for international patent applications, searches, preliminary examination, and related administrative matters. The page is the Table of Contents of the PCT (headings only).

rubrics_metrics.name: Preamble
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; full preamble text not included on this page. Indicates treaty context and purposes.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; introduces definitions and scope of the Treaty.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; signals the PCT's creation of a member-state union for international patent cooperation.

rubrics_metrics.description: Transmittal of the International Application to the International Bureau and the International Searching Authority

rubrics_metrics.description: Certain Defects in the International Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; concerns defects and possible remedies in the international application.

rubrics_metrics.description: Confidential Nature of the International Application

rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; relates to content and effect of the preliminary examination report.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only; addresses the interaction between national examination outcomes and PCT procedures.
